verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a hardware AI accelerator with a PyTorch/DeepSpeed/vLLM software stack. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows belongs to orchestration platforms, not to the accelerator itself, so this story is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Gaudi shipping its own job scheduler that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
